The Artist

Mariam Moheb

Mariam Moheb picked up a paintbrush for the first time between the ages of five and eight, and never really put it down. Self-taught, she began showing her work at local exhibitions at just thirteen, and went on to exhibit internationally across Italy, Germany, and the Netherlands, as well as taking home national competition wins along the way. Mory, the studio she founded, is where that lifelong instinct for color and meaning now lives — each piece painted by hand, one at a time.

Mory Studio is a subsidiary of Mensh Group.
